Subject: Exec workshop — East Bay pickup choreography & backup vehicles

Hi team,

We need to lock ground transport for the Veridian exec workshop on June 28 (0900-1700, Richmond Civic Center). Headcount is ~18 (12 execs + 6 support/staff). Notes: two guests use wheelchairs, and we have three heavy AV crates that must arrive by 0800.

My preliminary plan:
- 6 sedans for individual VIP pickup windows (6:45–7:30)
- 3 SUVs for paired execs with luggage (6:45–7:30)
- 2 12-passenger shuttles for staff and overflow (staging at Hotel B)
- 1 cargo van for AV crates (drop at loading dock 07:45)

Requests:
1) Can you confirm driver staging points and ETA buffers for I-80 congestion?
2) Lauren — can you check with facilities on a temporary loading permit at south curb (1 hour window 07:30–08:30)?
3) Marcus — please confirm vehicle assignments against the attendee list and flag any special dietary or mobility needs.

I've sketched pickup windows and tentative assignments in this sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/Veridian-Exec-Transfers (Sheet: pickup-timings). Attachment stub listed below.

[Attachment: pickup-timings.xlsx (xlsx, 38 KB)]

If we can get vendor confirmation by Thursday EOD, I will send final instructions to the drivers and to Veridian's onsite lead (Audrey).

Thanks — Soojin

Hi Soojin / Lauren / Marcus —

Appreciate the heads-up. Precision Mobility can cover the full plan below. Summary and exceptions:

- Fleet: 6 black sedans (Lincoln/Toyota), 3 SUVs (ramp-capable on request), 2 12p shuttles, 1 cargo van (insulated, lift gate).
- Staffing: Lead driver (Alpha) — Maya Singh (cell +1-510-555-0199). Backup lead (Bravo) available if Alpha is held.
- AV crate protocol: cargo van will stage at 06:50, with driver and one logistics assistant handling crate manifest and receipts.
- Wheelchair guests: we will dispatch one ADA van and an SUV with ramp; both drivers are trained for assisted boarding.
- Traffic contingency: if eastbound I-80 shows >15 mins delay, we will route via I-580 (adds ~12 minutes) and call an audible for the AV van to leave by 06:50 instead of 07:00.
- Pricing (estimate): $1,920 base for day of service (includes vehicle hours, drivers, and assistant). Hourly overtime $80/vehicle after 6pm.

We have attached the SOW and insurance certificate. To proceed we need:
1) Signed SOW (SOW-PrecisionMobility.pdf)
2) Final attendee pickup list with mobility flags by Fri EOD (23 June)
3) Confirmation on curb-permit submission contact (we can submit on your behalf with signed permission from Veridian)

[Attachment: SOW-PrecisionMobility.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

Happy to jump on a 15-minute call if helpful.
